title: Worked example: the missing context panel
summary: An excellent AI tool stalled at 11% adoption: the tool spoke, the user decided, and context was invisible to both. A context panel showing what information was available, what was missing and how confident the tool was made the third body legible. Adoption on that team reached 74% in three weeks; nothing about the tool or the users changed.
source: ChX — 'A Worked Example' (replaces the Blueprint figure)
